spec.name: Halloween Skeleton Bowling Pin
spec.description: A single ivory skeleton bowling pin with a little skull, narrow neck and stepped, rounded weighted base. Axis-aligned geometry fits x/z 4–12 and y 0–16. Dark painted sockets and teeth establish its Halloween character without extra props.

prompt: Single ivory skeleton-shaped bowling pin, little skull atop a narrow neck and weighted round base. x,z4..12 y0..16. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
